items.title: Share these readings with your care team
items.text: Only 68.7% of your readings were in the 70-180 range, and your average was 172.0 mg/dL. Bring this to your next visit to discuss.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You didn't walk after meals, but walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in sugar. Walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain, with a rise 17.5 mg/dL less in sugar.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: 50.0% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, and sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm, as sugar rose 13.3 mg/dL more after a dinner at 8-9 pm than after one before 6 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 11.9 hours, and none of your nights reached 13 hours. Adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
